cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 14 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

cancellationPolicies.label: Non-refundable rates
cancellationPolicies.description: Your booking is non-refundable. If you choose to cancel your booking, or in the case of a no-show, you will still be charged the full cost of your booking.

dorms.labelDescription:
This room is a 10 Bed Mixed Dorm with air-conditioning. It shares a bathroom with another 10 Bed Mixed Dorm. There is additional bathrooms outside of the room.

This room is Non-Refundable.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 2nd Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 2nd Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
